meta.siteDescription: Turn Markdown files into self-contained, editable URLs and compact divided links.
meta.aboutDescription: Learn how SkillsLink creates portable links and static pages for AI-readable documents.
meta.uploadDescription: Read a local Markdown file in the browser and create self-contained document and divided-part URLs.
meta.viewDescription: Recover, read, edit, and share a document stored inside its URL.

common.copyError: Could not copy to the clipboard.

home.lead: Read a .md file locally, pack it into compact optionally compressed Base64URL data, open the viewer, and optionally keep the link hierarchy in your private JSON registry.
home.proofRegistryText: User-level JSON or a custom path
home.resilienceTitle: Portable URLs and static repository pages.
home.resilienceLead: Generated links keep the document in the URL and recover it in the browser. Documents committed to this repository also receive pre-rendered HTML and raw-file routes for plain HTTP readers.

features.title: Self-contained URL
features.text: The versioned URL fragment carries the validated document, so the link can be opened without storing the file on a server or sending its payload in the HTTP request.

features.title: Editable viewer
features.text: Change the file name or content in the viewer and SkillsLink immediately creates an updated URL for copying.

features.title: Static AI route
features.text: Repository snapshots are exported as complete HTML and exact raw files, which makes them readable without client-side JavaScript.

home.flowTitle: From a file to a URL in three steps.

steps.title: Choose a file
steps.text: Use the CLI or browser page with a UTF-8 .md file no larger than {limit}.

steps.title: Generate and open
steps.text: SkillsLink validates the source, embeds it in the URL, prints the link, and opens the viewer when the terminal is interactive.

steps.title: Register if useful
steps.text: Confirm the optional prompt to keep the generated link in your user-level JSON registry for listing or removal later.

home.calloutTitle: A small document deserves a simple link.
home.calloutText: Run with npx or install globally. The command reads locally and never asks for a GitHub token.

about.title: A small, inspectable format for document links.
about.lead: SkillsLink packs a validated Markdown document into a compact versioned envelope, uses zlib when it produces fewer bytes, encodes it as Base64URL, and places it in the viewer URL.

sections.title: Versioned payload
sections.text: The URL carries the Markdown name and content without redundant media metadata. A version prefix keeps older links readable while the current format selects compressed or raw bytes for the shorter result.

sections.title: Static snapshots
sections.text: Documents added to the repository are exported as content-complete HTML and exact .md files during the GitHub Pages build.

sections.title: Local ownership
sections.text: The CLI registry lives in the operating system user-data directory or at a JSON path selected with configuration or an option.

about.guaranteeText: The codec validates the extension, media type, UTF-8 text, name, version, and {limit} limit. Repository builds also verify and render every stored snapshot.
about.limitationText: The portable viewer needs JavaScript to decode its URL fragment. An AI service may disable JavaScript, block GitHub Pages, or reject long URLs. For dependable plain HTTP reading, use a committed static document or its raw route.
about.repositoryText: Translation dictionaries live in the repository under a strict shared TypeScript contract. A contributor can add and review a language alongside the source.

upload.title: Turn a document into an editable link.
upload.lead: Choose a Markdown file. SkillsLink reads it only in this browser and generates compact portable links for the complete document and all of its semantic parts.
upload.limitText: Files larger than {limit} are blocked before they are read or encoded. Each generated part is limited to {partLimit}. Payloads stay in URL fragments and outside HTTP requests, preventing this document data from causing HTTP 431 responses.
upload.portableWarning: Compression and Base64URL are not encryption. Anyone with the complete link can read the document. Its fragment stays out of the HTTP request but can remain in browser history or be exposed when the link is copied. The viewer needs JavaScript; non-JavaScript clients should use a repository snapshot or raw-file URL.
upload.fullLinkHiddenTitle: The complete link exceeds the compatibility limit
upload.fullLinkHiddenText: SkillsLink generated the complete link but does not display it because it exceeds {urlLimit} characters. Use the ordered part links below; together they preserve the complete Markdown file.
upload.partLinksText: Every link carries one small semantic part. Read them in order to recover the complete skill.
upload.aiPromptText: This English prompt contains every divided link in order and is identical in all three site languages.
upload.splittingText: SkillsLink always creates the complete URL when it fits the compatibility limit. A shared CommonMark and GFM parser divides headings, paragraphs, fenced code blocks, list items, quotes, tables, and other Markdown blocks. Anything above {partLimit} is divided again at safe text boundaries.
upload.skillTipsTitle: Tips for an AI skill file
skillTips: Use one # heading for the skill name and purpose.
Separate triggers, workflow, output, and examples with focused ## and ### headings.
Keep paragraphs, code blocks, and list items below {partLimit}; move long examples or references into another .md file.
Exclude generated logs, binary data, embedded Base64, credentials, and secrets.
